subject.en: Right-facing faceted dove with an amber eye and pink blossom branches
subject.zh: 向右侧望的切面鸽子，琥珀色眼睛与粉色花枝

description.en: The amber eye and right-facing profile retain their direction. Blossoms frame the lower portrait loosely, while the neck continues past the bottom instead of ending in a round medallion.
description.zh: 保留琥珀色眼睛与向右侧望的姿态。花枝松散地环绕头像下方，颈部顺势延伸到画面外，花瓣四周留有清晰的空隙。

description.en: Slate, teal, and violet facets carry the iridescent plumage. Pink and ivory blossoms form the secondary focal point; pale petals and the light beak stay opaque and clean.
description.zh: 灰蓝、青绿与紫色切面构成有虹彩感的羽毛，粉色和象牙白花瓣形成第二处兴趣点。浅色花瓣与鸟喙保留完整、不透明的边缘。

description.en: An open petal-and-branch relief sits on a muted rose field. The motif follows the empty left side, leaving the bird and flowers clearly separated from the matte background.
description.zh: 开放的花瓣与枝条浅纹落在柔和的玫瑰色底面上。底纹沿左侧留白舒展，让鸽子与花朵清楚地浮现在哑光背景前。

sizeNote.en: At 32 px, the side profile, amber eye, and pink blossom collar carry the mark. At 16 px, stamens and individual petals merge into a soft pink accent around the blue silhouette.
sizeNote.zh: 在 32 px 下，侧脸、琥珀色眼睛与粉色花枝承担辨识度。缩到 16 px 时，花蕊和独立花瓣会合并为蓝色轮廓周围的柔和粉色点缀。
